name: Michael Accuosti
title: Controller
bio_short: Controller at IMPACT, leading the finance and HR functions.
bio_long:
Since graduating from Marist College in Poughkeepsie, NY, Michael has increased the depth and level of his finance and human resources accountabilities as he's scaled up and taken on more challenging roles throughout his 20+ year career.

Michael cut his teeth first in the media world, working in A/R and general accounting in radio, eye-witnessing an industry based in marketing and helping customers reach their potential. Continuing in media, Michael took on additional payroll responsibilities while working in accounting in newsprint. Michael then moved into the manufacturing industry, handling all aspects of accounting and HR in addition to purchasing and supply chain management.

Michael has now come full circle in returning to an industry hyper-focused on helping clients achieve their marketing and sales goals - uniquely with They Ask, You Answer - by leading IMPACT's finance department. Michael's goal is to combine his strong business acumen and caring with IMPACT's value system to create a positive and productive experience for anyone who interacts with our finance and HR team and systems.

Outside of crunching numbers at IMPACT, you can find Michael on his bike, on a hiking trail, playing cards, or off on some crazy travel adventure. What he loves the most, though, is spending time with friends and family.

name: Nancy Andrade
title: Project Manager
bio_short: Project Manager at IMPACT with a background in brand strategy and marketing.
bio_long:
With a Master's in Brand Strategy and over nine years of experience in marketing, Nancy has led impactful projects in advertising, fintech, BPO, and healthcare—collaborating with top agencies like Ogilvy and TBWA.

As a Project Manager, she thrives on optimizing workflows, launching campaigns, and delivering results-driven solutions. Fluent in English and Spanish (with some knowledge of Portuguese and French), she enjoys connecting with multicultural teams.

Outside of work, Nancy is a coffee enthusiast, a sunset chaser, and a Studio Ghibli fan on a mission to watch every film. When she's not working, she can often be found journaling, painting, or baking something sweet.

name: Joe Bachir
title: HubSpot Trainer
bio_short: HubSpot Trainer at IMPACT, helping companies get the most out of their inbound marketing efforts.
bio_long:
Being a HubSpot Trainer at IMPACT, Joe works with companies of all sizes to get the most out of their inbound marketing efforts. While this does include making sure that the clients are utilizing HubSpot effectively, it also means aligning the Sales and Marketing teams to ensure success throughout their Inbound marketing strategy.

As being a member of the HubSquad (IMPACT's team of awesome HubSpot trainers), Joe works one on one with clients on a weekly basis to develop and implement their Inbound and HubSpot strategy in a way that encourages clients to own and grow their success as a team.

Believe it or not, HubSpot is not the only thing Joe is passionate about. On his off days, you can catch him on the water kayaking, or finding the best new local spot to eat at.

name: Derek Baer
title: Sales Coach and Advisor
bio_short: Sales Coach and Advisor partnering with IMPACT to help clients implement the Endless Customers journey.
bio_long:
Since 2021, Derek Baer has partnered with IMPACT as a Sales Coach and Advisor, working alongside our coaches and sales advisors to help clients successfully implement the Endless Customers journey. In addition to his work with IMPACT, Derek serves as Vice President of Corporate Training at Kurlan & Associates, where he leads their Fractional Sales Leadership Services.

He's also the host of the Constructing Success Podcast, where he shares practical insights on sales, leadership, and personal growth with top performers and industry leaders.

As a former collegiate athlete and team captain, Derek learned firsthand the power of discipline, teamwork, and accountability. Today, he brings that same results-driven mindset to every client engagement, equipping sales teams and leaders with the strategies and coaching they need to achieve and exceed their goals.

name: Stephanie Baiocchi
title: Director of Membership & Events
bio_short: Leads membership and events at IMPACT and regularly moderates the Endless Customers webinar series.
bio_long:
Stephanie is the Director of Membership & Events at IMPACT and absolutely loves connecting with people and building relationships. At IMPACT, Stephanie works to create event and community experiences to bring digital sales and marketing professionals together to learn and grow in their roles.

Stephanie has been using HubSpot for 8 years across a variety of industries on the client and agency side and is the leader of the Chicago HubSpot User Group. She is a Carthage College graduate with a B.A. in Public Relations and German. She also owns a highly coveted HubSpot bicycle! You can catch Stephanie engaging with our community in our Facebook group, IMPACT Elite, or planning our variety of in-person and virtual events.

Outside of IMPACT, Stephanie loves photographing weddings, trying new restaurants and taking her dog, Penny, to the park.

name: John Ballou
title: Video & Creative Lead
bio_short: Video & Creative Lead at IMPACT.

name: John Becker
title: Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Coach, trainer, marketer, speaker, and writer at IMPACT.
bio_long:
John Becker is a coach, trainer, marketer, speaker, and writer.

A Connecticut native, John studied at UPenn, Middlebury, and UMass, and has worked in both corporate and nonprofit settings. Every day, he helps businesses improve how they sell, market, and communicate.

John is passionate about sustainability, education, design, and teamwork. He enjoys building furniture, swimming, and traveling with his family.

name: Allison Belles
title: Executive Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Executive Coach who trains sales, marketing, and leadership teams to embrace radical transparency.
bio_long:
Allison excels as a catalyst for transformation within organizations across the globe. She trains sales, marketing, and leadership teams to embrace a culture of radical transparency within their organizations, empowering them to become the most trusted voice in their space.

With deep roots in the marketing world she has used her in-house and agency experiences to prove the value of great content, great communication and great leadership. All of which ultimately lead to more cohesive, productive teams; increased revenue; and more trust with buyers.

name: Mary Brown
title: Website Strategist
bio_short: Lead Website Strategist guiding clients through website projects and strategy.
bio_long:
As Lead Web Strategist, Mary guides clients through their website projects. She runs hands-on strategy sessions with clients to create site plans that will deliver the bottom-line results they're looking for and trains them to manage and continuously optimize the site so they can truly own it in-house after launch.

When she's not working you can usually find Mary spending time outside with her husband Greg and son Julian. Together with their Czech Shepard, Magnus, they usually spend weekends hiking the forests and mountains of New England.

name: Cielo Cabalfin
title: Community Coordinator
bio_short: Community Coordinator connecting IMPACT's community with the team to explore Endless Customers.
bio_long:
I'm Cielo Cabalfin. I'm passionate about Endless Customers and have seen firsthand the power it has to help businesses bring their visions to life. One of the best parts of my role is connecting with our community and helping introduce them to members of our team to explore how Endless Customers might help them achieve their business goals.

I was born in the Philippines, grew up in Vancouver, British Columbia, and spent time in Connecticut before moving back to the Philippines. I bring more than 25 years of experience across business, leadership, and digital industries. I earned my Bachelor's degree in Business Management and Travel and Tourism Management from Sprott Shaw College.

In my free time, I enjoy travelling, learning new things, reading books, dining out, and spending time with my family.

name: Brian Casey
title: Sr. Coach
bio_short: Sr. Coach using a background in sales and inbound marketing to coach clients on content that impacts sales.
bio_long:
Brian uses his background in sales & inbound marketing strategy to coach clients on creating content that impacts sales. As a salesperson, he experienced the first-hand struggles of legacy sales tactics. Through these struggles, he came to learn inbound marketing and became obsessed.

His experience in working with clients spans across all types of businesses in unique markets. He enjoys teaching content marketing strategies to help these businesses reach their ideal buyers.

Outside of work, Brian enjoys coaching and playing Ultimate Frisbee. He has been an advisor and coach to his alma mater, UNC-Wilmington, since 2012. He also enjoys discovering new music and attending concerts in and around Charlotte.

name: Nicole Cimo
title: VP of Sales & Marketing
bio_short: VP of Sales & Marketing, a data-driven marketer with deep events-industry experience.
bio_long:
Nicole is a versatile marketer with over 10 years of experience. With a B.A. in Mass Communications from Towson University, Nicole started her career in marketing in the events industry and has had the opportunity to work on worldwide executive conferences including the FORTUNE Global Forum, McKinsey's Global Infrastructure Initiative, the Experiential Marketing Summit and more.

As Event Marketing Director for IMPACT, Nicole is tasked with driving attendance for IMPACT's virtual and live events. She is data-driven and focuses heavily on insights and industry trends to inform marketing decisions.

Outside of work, Nicole enjoys taking spin classes, traveling with her husband and hiking with her King Charles Cavalier.

name: Katie Coelho
title: President & Integrator
bio_short: President & Integrator at IMPACT, leading day-to-day operations, client success, and financial performance.
bio_long:
Katie Coelho is the President and Integrator at IMPACT. With over 12 years at the company, she has played a pivotal role in shaping its growth and evolution. Today, she leads day-to-day operations, oversees client success, and manages financial performance—ensuring both the business and its clients continue to thrive.

Katie is passionate about empowering her team, helping individuals grow with confidence, and celebrating their milestones along the way. She finds it especially rewarding to watch client journeys unfold through Endless Customers, as they overcome sales and marketing challenges to achieve real, lasting growth.

Outside of work, Katie enjoys spending time with her husband and twinnies, traveling, exploring new restaurants with friends, and relaxing on Long Beach Island—ideally with a spicy margarita in hand.

name: Reagan Cotton
title: Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Coach at IMPACT.

name: Tom DiScipio
title: Managing Partner & Client Advisor
bio_short: Managing Partner & Client Advisor at IMPACT, leading product and client advisory.
bio_long:
Tom DiScipio leads the product team responsible for the design and engineering of IMPACT+: IMPACT's online learning community dedicated to educating marketers, salespeople and business leaders on achieving digital sales and marketing mastery within their organizations.

Beyond the day-to-day, Tom balances life at IMPACT as a hobbyist photographer, guitar player, and wannabe (BMW) race car driver.

name: Carolyn Edgecomb
title: Content & Community Coordinator
bio_short: Content & Community Coordinator and Chief of Staff for the Marketing and Membership team.
bio_long:
Carolyn acts as the Chief of Staff for the Marketing and Membership team, keeping projects organized and aligned with strategic goals. She brings structure to planning, clarity to priorities, and consistency to execution, so the team can move forward with confidence.

After years of working across marketing, community, and operations at IMPACT, Carolyn has a deep understanding of how the business runs and how teams collaborate. She uses that experience to streamline communication, anticipate needs, and build systems that make daily work easier for everyone.

In her role as Content and Community Coordinator, Carolyn manages internal workflows, supports content and community initiatives, and helps maintain a steady rhythm across all projects. She is often the connecting point between ideas and execution, making sure details are handled and progress continues.

Outside of work, Carolyn enjoys trying new recipes, listening to country music, and reading.

name: Daniel Escardo
title: Web Developer
bio_short: Sr. Front-end Developer creating dynamic websites and exceptional user experiences.
bio_long:
Daniel is a Web Developer at IMPACT, and has been designing / developing complex websites for over 20 years.

He started his career working as a graphic designer and print producer for advertising agencies in Miami, FL, where he was born and raised. Since his transition to web, his absolute passion is creating dynamic websites that provide an exceptional user experience to help increase traffic and improve SEO.

Outside of IMPACT he's a husband, a doting father, and loves anything on the ocean.

name: Cassie Findley
title: Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Coach at IMPACT.

name: Vin Gaeta
title: Executive Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Executive Coach and Head of Web Strategy, helping companies drive revenue growth from their websites.
bio_long:
Vin has been successfully implementing creative sales and marketing strategies, building long-lasting relationships, and guiding the process for successful website builds since the early days of IMPACT. As Head of Web Strategy, he helps companies create easy-to-manage websites and trains them on the specific areas to focus on that drive real revenue growth from your site.

In his free time, you can find him spending time outdoors with his wife and two daughters, collecting comic books, and playing video games. Did we mention he's a huge geek?

name: Tanner Holman
title: Paid Media Specialist
bio_short: Paid Social Strategist at IMPACT.

name: Brett Ingram
title: Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Coach at IMPACT.

name: Ashley Jensen
title: Content Manager
bio_short: Content Manager creating educational content that helps businesses build trust and grow.
bio_long:
Ashley is a marketer and content strategist with a commitment to creating content that drives sales objectives and makes meaningful connections. She has worked across agencies, freelance content creation, and in-house marketing roles.

As the Content Manager at IMPACT, she creates educational content that helps businesses build trust, align marketing and sales, and grow through customer-first strategies.

Outside work, you'll find her reading too many books at once, brushing up on random trivia, or biking around town.

name: Jason Linde
title: Paid Media Specialist
bio_short: Google Ads Lead and Paid Media Specialist with 15+ years in digital marketing.
bio_long:
Jason joined IMPACT after spending the last 15+ years in the digital marketing space, while concentrating in paid advertising for the past 8 years while working alongside his wife while running a successful agency of their own.

Jason has a passion for search marketing and helping people grow and succeed within the paid space.

When he's not working, you'll find Jason searching for the best outdoor spots for hiking or biking. If not outdoors, he is spending time with his wife finding the best hidden craft beer spots to sample up and down the east coast to eat.

name: Janet Mendez
title: Website Strategist
bio_short: Website Strategist running hands-on strategy sessions to build easy-to-manage, sales-driving websites.
bio_long:
As a Web Strategist, Janet runs hands-on strategy sessions with clients to build easy-to-manage websites that not only align with their business goals but also drive real sales. She empowers her clients with the knowledge and tools they need to take ownership of their websites, ensuring they can manage and optimize them long after the launch.

Janet brings a wealth of experience in project management and client relations. Her unique skill set allows her to guide clients through the complexities of web design and marketing, ensuring they achieve bottom-line results.

When she's not immersed in her work, you can find her traveling to new cities with her husband, at a local coffee shop or reading a good book. She's also passionate about portrait photography and leading worship at her local church.

name: Austin Mock
title: Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Coach teaching companies to implement the Endless Customers System using buyer-first content.
bio_long:
Austin is passionate about helping businesses grow the right way.

As a coach at IMPACT, he teaches companies how to implement the Endless Customers System, using content to create transparency, build trust, and empower buyers to make confident decisions.

Before stepping into coaching, Austin spent over a decade working in professional video and content production across corporate and nonprofit environments, including producing documentary work for PBS. He has written and produced buyer-focused content that answers tough questions, addresses concerns openly, and supports sales teams without relying on pressure tactics.

Austin believes the most effective sales and marketing strategies are rooted in honesty. His work centers on aligning leadership, marketing, and sales teams around content that puts the buyer first.

When he's not coaching businesses, you'll likely find him watching the Denver Broncos, playing pickup ice hockey, or spending time with his family.

name: Melanie Moore
title: VP of Finance & Admin
bio_short: VP of Finance & Admin at IMPACT with deep website project management roots.
bio_long:
Back in 2011, Melanie fell in love with websites (bet you thought she was going to say something else). She graduated from Quinnipiac University in 2005 and worked in television for years before making the leap over to inbound marketing and websites.

Working as a website project manager at IMPACT, helping clients achieve a clear, conversion-based website while solving technical issues along the way is her top priority. She is consistently organized, patient and always eager to learn the next big thing with a smile on her face.

Outside of work, she's a passionate dance teacher. So if learning to tap dance is a secret bucket list item of yours, she's your girl!

name: Rachel Palmateer
title: VP of Agency Services
bio_short: VP of Agency Services and Director of Paid Media, passionate about the psychology of buyer behavior.
bio_long:
Rachel is the Director of Paid Media at IMPACT. She is passionate about all things marketing and the psychology that drives buyer behavior.

With 10+ years of experience in the industry, she brings experience and a knack for looking at things from a different angle to her team and clients.

Based in Kentucky, Rachel can usually be found laughing at her dogs and getting out into the woods for some stellar hiking.

name: Jessica Palmeri
title: Lead HubSpot Trainer
bio_short: Director of HubSpot Training with 10+ years of hands-on HubSpot experience.
bio_long:
Jessica is the Director of HubSpot Training with a long track record of leveraging HubSpot as a marketer, as well as training HubSpot clients on how to maximize their investment in the tool.

Jessica has 10+ years of hands-on HubSpot experience. She works with clients to up their inbound marketing game, consider out-of-the-box automation strategies, and ultimately achieve their organizational goals.

She's active in Certified HubSpot Trainer User Groups and periodically connects with product managers at HubSpot to provide feedback on their product roadmap.

When she's not HubSpotting, Jessica loves to tackle new recipes in the kitchen, and she's always down for a good road trip or weekend hike to enjoy spending time outside (away from her laptop).

name: Kaitlyn Petro
title: HubSpot Trainer
bio_short: Head of Web Design & Development, overseeing a team of website designers and front-end developers.
bio_long:
Kaitlyn joined IMPACT over 12 years ago, shortly after graduating college with a Bachelor of Science degree in Psychology.

Throughout the years, she's been a part of many departments, including marketing, sales, client services, & operations. She currently serves as the Head of Web Design & Development, where she oversees and manages a team of highly talented website designers and front-end developers.

Outside of IMPACT, Kaitlyn's favorite things include playing softball and volleyball, practicing karate, and cuddling with her adorable pup, Kobe.

name: Joe Rinaldi
title: Web Designer
bio_short: Creative Director, Brand and multidisciplinary designer shaping IMPACT's visual identity.
bio_long:
Joe Rinaldi is a multidisciplinary designer who has spent over a decade shaping brand and digital experiences for hundreds of companies across a wide range of industries.

He brings expertise in creative direction, UX/UI, brand development, and a little bit of "let's make this awesome" energy to every project. He loves the blend of strategy and creativity, taking messy ideas and turning them into clean, thoughtful design that works in the real world.

Since joining IMPACT in 2011, Joe has played a key role in the organization's creative evolution by leading major website redesigns, brand initiatives, and the ongoing development of IMPACT's visual identity.

Outside of work, Joe keeps things grounded: long runs, hiking, spending time with his nephews, and never missing a chance to cheer on his NY Giants (even when they make it difficult).

name: Reyna Yareli Rodríguez
title: Project Manager
bio_short: Project Manager at IMPACT.

name: Bob Ruffolo
title: CEO & Visionary
bio_short: Founder and CEO of IMPACT and host of the Endless Customers podcast.
bio_long:
Bob Ruffolo is the founder and CEO of IMPACT, a coaching and training company that helps businesses improve their sales, marketing, communication, and leadership. Founded in 2009, IMPACT started as a small marketing agency but has since grown into a leading provider of business coaching and training services. Under Bob's guidance, the company has been honored with several awards including being named HubSpot Partner of the Year twice and being recognized multiple times as a great place to work. Additionally, the company has made the Inc 5000 list 5 years in a row.

Bob is relentlessly focused on helping people grow as professionals and as leaders. The purpose of IMPACT is to create heroes, grow businesses, and change lives, a responsibility he takes very seriously. The company is on a mission to impact 10,000 businesses all over the world. Bob is humbled by the recognition he has received, including being a 40 under 40 winner and being listed on Glassdoor's Best CEO for Small Businesses list. He also believes in giving back to the community and currently sits on the board of several non-profits and charitable foundations.

In his free time, Bob enjoys running, travel, checking out new restaurants, and sipping on his favorite bourbon. He is a fan of the New York Yankees, New York Jets, and Ohio State football. Bob is a driven and passionate leader always looking for ways to improve and make a positive impact in the world.

name: Sarah Schreck
title: Graphic Designer
bio_short: Graphic Designer and paid ads specialist blending storytelling with conversion-focused creative.

name: Marcus Sheridan
title: Keynote Speaker, Author & Partner
bio_short: International keynote speaker and author of They Ask, You Answer, helping businesses become the most trusted voice in their industry.
bio_long:
In late 2009, Sheridan started his sales, marketing, and personal development blog—The Sales Lion. Before merging with IMPACT, he grew its brand to be synonymous with Inbound and Content Marketing excellence.

Today, Marcus is an international keynote speaker known for his unique ability to excite, engage and motivate live audiences. He also works with hundreds of businesses, helping them to become the most trusted voice in their industry.

Marcus has also been featured in multiple industry publications, including the New York Times where he was referred to as a "web Marketing guru." His book "They Ask, You Answer" has inspired thousands to achieve their potential but has given them the tools they need to get there.

Today, when Sheridan isn't giving riveting and passion-filled keynotes, he generally finds himself on an adventure with his wife and 4 children.

name: Melissa Smith
title: Web Developer
bio_short: Web Team Manager and Sr. Front-end Developer with 15+ years creating unique web experiences.
bio_long:
You can say Melissa was in love with all things computers since the day she learned to walk (and has a picture to prove it). Having a love for IT, you think she would go to school to be an IT nerd, but instead went in the direction of graphic design.

After a handful of years of doing both web design and web development, she followed her heart and went in the direction of solely focusing on web development.

With over 15 years of experience, Melissa collaborates with developers and designers to create unique web experiences for our clients and works with the team during the sales process to help identify the best package for each project.

Outside of work you can find Melissa, spending time with family, going to UCONN Women's Basketball games and even some Final Four weekends, traveling to Pittsburgh or the Jersey Shore, or watching/listening to any Pittsburgh sports.

name: Justine Timoteo Thomas
title: Director of People Development
bio_short: Director of People Development leading a team of account managers and championing client strategy.
bio_long:
Justine leads, manages and ensures the highest quality of work is delivered on a daily basis from her team of account managers.

She discovered her passion for inbound marketing more than six years ago and has worked directly with clients to establish successful strategies ever since. Though she loves bouncing ideas off of her desk-mate Nelle, her gray tabby cat, Justine doesn't always get the feedback she needs.

So instead, you can find her excited to hop onto video calls with her fellow IMPACTers each day. When she's not in her home office, Justine can be found exploring the vibrant areas of Cleveland, Ohio, and adding more stamps to her passport -- 15 countries and counting!

name: Mandy York
title: Endless Customers Coach
bio_short: Coach combining experience as an award-winning educator and business owner to drive content and video marketing goals.
bio_long:
Mandy York combines her experience as an award-winning educator and thriving business owner to help others take creative and actionable steps toward their content and video marketing goals. Her greatest strengths lie in her ability to foster relationships, seek common ground and provide real-world insight.

After obtaining her Master's degree in Leadership in 2018, she moved to the quiet, rural home she shares with her son and her dog Bo.

The three of them enjoy frequent hiking and days spent on the lake.

name: Kaitlyn Pintarich
title: Owner
bio_short: Owner of Berry Insurance and an Endless Customers client.

name: Jessica Turner
title: Operations Manager
bio_short: Operations Manager and Endless Customers client.

name: Alex
title: Marketing Lead
bio_short: Endless Customers client and podcast guest from CSI Accounting & Payroll.

name: Jordan
title: Content Manager
bio_short: Endless Customers client and podcast guest from CSI Accounting & Payroll.

name: Jeffrey Linta
title: CEO
bio_short: CEO of Linta Roofing in Myrtle Beach and an Endless Customers client.

name: Bryn Jones
title: General Manager, MoveMobility
bio_short: General Manager at MoveMobility, a builder of wheelchair-accessible vehicles and mobile medical clinics, who led the company's Endless Customers transformation.
bio_long: Bryn Jones is the General Manager of MoveMobility, a Canadian company that builds wheelchair-accessible vehicles and mobile medical clinics that remove barriers to care. Bryn led MoveMobility's shift from treating marketing as "the dusty corner of the company" to insourcing a content and video team and implementing the Endless Customers System, helping drive roughly $6M in revenue in the first five months of a single year.

name: Jorge Gonzalez
title: Marketing Lead, MoveMobility
bio_short: Marketing Lead at MoveMobility, helping build the company's in-house content and video engine.
bio_long: Jorge Gonzalez is the Marketing Lead at MoveMobility, where he helped build the company's insourced content and video operation as part of their Endless Customers journey. By putting real salespeople on camera, Jorge helped make first sales calls feel familiar to prospects who had already met the team through video.

name: Mike Ritzema
title: Founder, Superior Trucking Payroll Service
bio_short: Founder of Superior Trucking Payroll Service, a specialized payroll provider for trucking companies.
bio_long: Mike Ritzema is the founder of Superior Trucking Payroll Service (STPS), a specialized payroll service for trucking companies that exists to solve the recurring payroll and compliance headaches generalist providers miss. A self-described "farmer, not a hunter," Mike committed to educating buyers and, after getting an IMPACT coach and a weekly cadence, roughly tripled the company's sales opportunities.

name: Andy Roe
title: CEO, Roe Painting
bio_short: CEO of Roe Painting, who brought marketing in house and rebuilt the company's website around buyer trust.
bio_long: Andy Roe is the CEO of Roe Painting, a painting company with a strong brand and decades of momentum. Andy led the decision to stop renting marketing from outside vendors, bring content and video in house, rebuild the website around buyer questions, and commit to the Endless Customers System with coaching, tripling qualified leads in the process.

name: Josh Smith
title: Co-Owner & COO, Dental ClaimSupport
bio_short: Co-Owner and COO of Dental ClaimSupport, a dental billing company that scaled with They Ask, You Answer.
bio_long: Josh Smith is the Co-Owner and COO of Dental ClaimSupport, which he co-founded with Ryan DeLettre and Davy Clay to free dental offices from the time drain of insurance and paperwork. Josh helped lead the company's shift away from paid ads to a They Ask, You Answer content strategy with IMPACT, driving a 192% increase in deals won.

name: Ryan DeLettre
title: CEO, Dental ClaimSupport
bio_short: CEO and co-founder of Dental ClaimSupport, a dental billing company that scaled with IMPACT coaching.
bio_long: Ryan DeLettre is the CEO and a co-founder of Dental ClaimSupport, a dental billing company built to free dental offices from the time drain of insurance and paperwork. Ryan credits IMPACT's coaching and accountability as the biggest asset in the company's record-breaking growth with They Ask, You Answer.

name: Jim Schultz
title: President & Founder, Applied Educational Systems
bio_short: President and founder of Applied Educational Systems, a digital curriculum business serving teachers for 30+ years.
bio_long: Jim Schultz is the President and founder of Applied Educational Systems (AES), a Pennsylvania-based digital curriculum business that has empowered teachers for more than 30 years. After a pivot to a subscription software model wiped out AES's lead flow, Jim went all-in on They Ask, You Answer with IMPACT, growing to close to 30,000 organic leads annually and landing on Inc.'s 5,000 Fastest Growing Companies list four times in a row.

name: Dan Godla
title: Founder & CEO, ThoroughCare
bio_short: Founder and CEO of ThoroughCare, a digital health technology company that doubled revenue four years running.
bio_long: Dan Godla is the founder and CEO of ThoroughCare, a Pittsburgh-based digital health technology company whose care coordination software helps healthcare practices deliver value-based care management. A healthcare industry veteran, Dan built ThoroughCare from a single patient assessment tool and, by insourcing marketing and following They Ask, You Answer with IMPACT, grew the business at roughly 100% year over year.

name: Brad Dalinghaus
title: Co-Owner, Dalinghaus Construction
bio_short: Co-Owner of Dalinghaus Construction, a Southern California foundation repair company that grew sales 40% in a year.
bio_long: Brad Dalinghaus co-founded Dalinghaus Construction in Southern California in 2011 with his brother Brian, growing it to a team of almost 60 focused on foundation repair and concrete work across California and Arizona. By committing the whole company to They Ask, You Answer, Brad helped grow sales by about 40% in a single year while taking full control of the company's sales and marketing.

name: Ryan Litwiller
title: Marketing Director, RetroFoam of Michigan
bio_short: Marketing Director at RetroFoam of Michigan, a spray foam insulation contractor that doubled its business with content.
bio_long: Ryan Litwiller is the Marketing Director at RetroFoam of Michigan, a statewide spray foam insulation contractor. Ryan helped lead RetroFoam's content marketing transformation with IMPACT, seeing organic traffic grow from 7,000 sessions a year to more than 300,000 and increasing organic leads by 2,942% as the business more than doubled.

name: Rick LaGore
title: CEO, InTek Freight & Logistics
bio_short: CEO of InTek Freight & Logistics, who personally wrote his company's content and grew leads by 1,300%.
bio_long: Rick LaGore is the CEO of InTek Freight & Logistics. Rather than hiring a content manager, Rick took it upon himself to write all of the company's content, producing 92 blog articles in a single year addressing the questions his prospects cared about most. His commitment to customer education through They Ask, You Answer grew leads by 1,300% and built a $5 million sales pipeline from near-zero.

name: Colin Silkwood
title: Videographer, West Roofing Systems
bio_short: Videographer at West Roofing Systems, a commercial roofing contractor that grew web traffic 5,252% with content and video.
bio_long: Colin Silkwood is the in-house videographer at West Roofing Systems, a Cleveland-based commercial roofing contractor. Hired in 2018 to repurpose the company's written content into video, Colin helped West Roofing build a strong YouTube presence and supported a They Ask, You Answer strategy that grew web traffic 5,252% and generated job bids valued at over $14 million.

name: Jenna Scapinello
title: Director, Sales
bio_short: Director of Sales at Vidyard, helping revenue teams use video and AI to accelerate deal velocity and engagement.
bio_long: Jenna Scapinello is Director of Sales at Vidyard, where she helps revenue teams adopt AI-powered video and selling strategies that accelerate deal velocity, reduce no-shows, and grow expansion revenue.

name: Binayak Kanungo
title: Senior Solutions Consultant
bio_short: Senior Solutions Consultant at Vidyard, helping teams use AI avatars and video to build trust at scale.
bio_long: Most of Binayak's professional experience has taken place in the private sector, whether as an independent contractor, an analyst for a publicly traded company, or as part of a budding startup experiencing hyper growth. Across these experiences he has come to understand the roles firms play in their communities and the effects their actions have on stakeholders. As an individual, Binayak has gained an appreciation of the soft skills needed to motivate those around him to be comfortable while working at their best.

name: Will Smith
title: HubSpot Trainer
bio_short: HubSpot Trainer who helps teams stop underutilizing their CRM and turn it into a revenue driver.
bio_long: Will Smith is a HubSpot Trainer who helps companies understand why so many of them underutilize their CRMs and, more importantly, how to start using HubSpot to increase revenue by up to 41% per salesperson.

name: Alexander Ronzino
title: Partner at Rework Capital and Fractional CFO, IMPACT
bio_short: Partner at Rework Capital and IMPACT's Fractional CFO, focused on helping business leaders gear up for scaling and acquisition.
bio_long: Embarking on his entrepreneurial journey at 22, Alex became the youngest CEO in healthcare history with VC backing, scaling from a concept to a multi-facility provider, a feat recognized in FSU's 30 Under 30 accolades. After eight transformative years there, Alex transitioned to serving as COO/CFO of a $300MM/year/GMV technology company. Today, at Rework Capital, he is focused on helping business leaders gear up for scaling and success, and serves as IMPACT's Fractional CFO.

name: Dan Kerr
title: Co-Founder & Chief Revenue Officer
bio_short: Co-founder of AdjusterPro and an Endless Customers client who has led the company's marketing vision since 2005.
bio_long: Dan Kerr is the co-founder of AdjusterPro and has helped lead the company's marketing vision, online presence, and industry-leading educational resources since 2005. From the beginning, Dan has focused on creating an exceptional experience for students through strong customer support, practical resources, and a commitment to continuous improvement. His drive to keep innovating has helped shape AdjusterPro into a trusted leader in the insurance adjuster training industry.

name: Adam Gardiner
title: Co-Founder
bio_short: Co-founder of AdjusterPro and an Endless Customers client passionate about careers in insurance adjusting.
bio_long: Adam Gardiner is the co-founder of AdjusterPro and a passionate advocate for careers in insurance adjusting. After finding success as an adjuster himself, he saw how difficult it was for people to break into the industry without guidance or access to reliable training. What began as a single state licensing course has grown into the nation's leading provider of insurance adjuster licensing, exam prep, and continuing education courses.

name: Mark Rodgers
title: President & Founder
bio_short: President and founder of Trailstone Insurance and an Endless Customers client.
bio_long: Mark Rodgers is the president and founder of Trailstone Insurance, an independent insurance agency headquartered in Colorado and operating across seven states. He founded Trailstone in 2013 with a focus on education-first customer relationships and has grown the agency from seven to nearly 70 people by building systems around trust, transparency, and content.

name: Marquece Cunningham
title: Marketing Director
bio_short: Marketing Director at Trailstone Insurance and an Endless Customers client.
bio_long: Marquece Cunningham is Trailstone's Marketing Director, bringing nearly 20 years of marketing experience and a background in SaaS and software. He joined Trailstone in 2025 and now leads the company's content strategy, website, video production, and digital presence.

name: Stacie Feller
title: President
bio_short: President of KangaRoof in Round Rock, Texas, and an Endless Customers client.
bio_long: Stacie Feller is the president of KangaRoof, a residential roofing company based in Round Rock, Texas. She oversees all operations and has spent the last ten years building a team and culture focused on trust, education, and long-term customer relationships.

name: Marcos Navarro
title: Videographer
bio_short: Videographer at TMA Accounting and an Endless Customers podcast guest.
bio_long: Marcos Navarro is the videographer at TMA Accounting, a small business accounting firm that handles accounting, taxes, and payroll all under one roof. He believes every person has a story worth telling and uses video to position the firm as a guide inside the customer's story.

name: Caitlin Vegas
title: Marketing Lead
bio_short: Marketing lead at Equity Roofing and an Endless Customers client.
bio_long: Caitlin Vegas leads marketing at Equity Roofing, where she championed a transparent pricing page that drove a 58% jump in form submissions by answering the cost questions homeowners are already asking.
